policy: Preserve all alternatives; evaluator must explicitly qualify a scope for any runtime use. A synthetic test resolution does not correct the paper.

conflicts.description: Prose uses 1000 frames; Fig. 3c caption uses 7000; SI maps Fig. 3c to sets 20-26.
Fig. 4 caption specifies 856 arcsec; prediction prose and ED9 use 865 arcsec.
Prose reports 195 nm RMSE reduction; caption gives 224.10 to 109.84 nm. Averaging-scope equivalence is not established.
SI maps prediction to seven 1000-frame sets (7000 total); Methods selects 6000 with a 5400/600 split. Exact exclusion is unspecified.
Demonstration uses 300 frames; generic Methods mentions about 1000 over 30 s. These are separate scopes, not interchangeable recipes.
Separate fine-tuning corpus has 600 frames; SI sets 27 and 28 have only 200 each. No written mapping is certified.
